AI Customer Support

Forethought

Forethought provides AI agents and support-operations tools for resolving customer requests, assisting agents, triaging tickets and analyzing service quality.

What is Forethought?

Forethought is an AI customer-support platform that combines autonomous resolution with agent assistance, triage and support intelligence. Its product suite is built for support organizations that want AI to handle customer conversations and also improve the surrounding service workflow, while commercial plans add channels, analytics, governance and API access.

Best for: Mid-market and enterprise support teams that want AI resolution plus triage, agent assistance and support analytics in one platform.

Main features

  • AI support agents
  • Automated resolution workflows
  • Agent-assistance tools
  • Ticket triage
  • Support insights and QA
  • Email, voice and Slack options on higher tiers
  • Solve and analytics APIs on eligible plans

Use cases

  • Resolve repetitive support tickets
  • Assist human support agents
  • Classify and route incoming requests
  • Analyze support trends and quality
  • Automate multi-step customer-service workflows

Who is it for?

  • customer support teams
  • support operations
  • CX leaders
  • SaaS support organizations
  • enterprise service teams

Pricing and plans

platform subscription plus outcome-based usage

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Combines customer-facing automation with internal support operations
  • Supports multi-step workflows and multiple service channels on higher plans
  • Enterprise plans expose APIs for deeper integration

Limitations

  • Pricing is quote-based rather than publicly listed
  • Forethought states that overage charges can apply depending on usage
  • It does not offer a traditional self-service free trial; evaluation is handled through a Proof of Value process

Review method

Research supplied by the directory editor; not independently verified or hands-on tested for this import. The research date is supplied by the source. Confirm current plans, restrictions and capabilities using the official links below.

Frequently asked questions

Does Forethought publish its prices?

No public numeric starting price is shown on the checked pricing page; Team, Pro and Enterprise are sold through quote-based purchasing.

Can I start a normal free trial?

Forethought says it does not use a traditional free-trial model. Prospective customers can instead run a Proof of Value evaluation.

Does Forethought offer APIs?

Yes. Its pricing page lists Solve API and Analytics API capabilities in the higher-tier offering.
